text.p: SKOPJE, March 31 - These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
- Minister for Construction Jorgo Sundovski denies any link with scandal-ridden TAT financial institution, says there is no reason for him to resign.
- Association of depositors complains about authorities' tardy handing of TAT problem.
- Bitola city Mayor Siljan Micevski and wife arrested on suspicion of involvement in TAT scandal. Municipal authorities to discuss problem on Tuesday.
